async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill the title field
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)", exact=True)
    await title_field.fill("404 for many URLs")
    
    # Step 2: Assign the issue to myself
    # Look for assignee field; it might be a button or combobox with name containing "Assign"
    assignee_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Assign", exact=False)
    if await assignee_button.count() > 0:
        await assignee_button.click()
        # After clicking, look for option to assign to me
        assign_to_me_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Assign to me", exact=True)
        if await assign_to_me_option.count() > 0:
            await assign_to_me_option.click()
        else:
            # If no specific option, try to select the current user by name; assume first option
            first_option = page.get_by_role("option").first
            await first_option.click()
    else:
        # If not a button, try combobox
        assignee_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assign", exact=False)
        if await assignee_combobox.count() > 0:
            await assignee_combobox.click()
            assign_to_me_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Assign to me", exact=True)
            if await assign_to_me_option.count() > 0:
                await assign_to_me_option.click()
            else:
                first_option = page.get_by_role("option").first
                await first_option.click()
    
    # Step 3: Set due date to 2030-1-3
    due_date_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date", exact=False)
    if await due_date_field.count() > 0:
        await due_date_field.fill("2030-01-03")
    else:
        # If not found by name, try to find by role "textbox" with a placeholder or similar; but use only accessibility selectors
        # Use get_by_role with partial name match for other possible names
        due_date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due", exact=False)
        if await due_date_input.count() > 0:
            await due_date_input.fill("2030-01-03")
    
    # Step 4: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue", exact=True)
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
